summary: PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics treats any direct child named UNRENDERED_PhysicsLabDiagnostics that is a Folder with mutable UNRENDERED_PhysicsLabDiagnosticsOwned == true as the project-owned diagnostics root. The helper does not bind that Folder to the exact Instance created by enable(). A substituted/spoofed same-name Folder can therefore be reported as enabled, block enable(), and—most critically—be destroyed by disable()/runToggleEvidence() even though it is outside diagnostics runtime ownership.
evidence: src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.luau diagnosticsRoot(model) uses FindFirstChild(DIAGNOSTICS_ROOT_NAME), Folder class, and the mutable UNRENDERED_PhysicsLabDiagnosticsOwned attribute as its complete ownership proof; there is no private exact-Instance authority binding.

disable(lab) calls diagnosticsRoot(lab.model) and destroys the returned Folder. A caller or external Studio mutation can replace the original owned Folder with a same-name Folder carrying the ownership attribute, after which disable() destroys the substitute rather than failing closed.

capture(lab) also accepts that substitute as enabled and counts its descendants, while enable(lab) treats it as an already-enabled owned root. runToggleEvidence() begins with disable(lab), so the destructive substitution path is reachable from the evidence helper without any prior exact-root verification.

Merged failure-atomicity work #285 protects the Folder created by a single enable() transaction, but its same-name fence still relies on the same ownership attribute and does not preserve exact identity across later calls.

Active PR #349 adds an exact private-map Instance predicate for physical WorldEntity representations, not for the diagnostics root Folder. Active #374 covers one-to-one readout descendant completeness. Neither binds the diagnostics root itself to exact runtime ownership.

A bounded source repair should retain the exact Folder Instance in private diagnostics state, require it to remain the direct child of the canonical lab model, reject substituted/reparented/stale roots before capture/enable/disable mutation, and ensure disable destroys only the exact owned Instance. Pure regression should cover replacement, reparenting, stale identity, and spoofed ownership-attribute cases without claiming Studio evidence.
